description_en: Queries the trajectory details of a device

kebab_example: aliyun iot gis-search-device-trace --map-match 0 --end-time 1645071254000 --start-time 1645071254000 --product-key g3r0000Vjta --device-name mock_device_name --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GisSearchDeviceTrace

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to correct the location based on the map. Valid values:
0: No. Trajectory correction is not performed.
1: Yes. Trajectory correction is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否结合地图进行位置纠偏。可取值：
0：否，不进行轨迹纠偏。
1：是，进行轨迹纠偏
parameters.name: map_match

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the trajectory, in milliseconds
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the trajectory, in milliseconds
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
A ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a new product. You can view the information of all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属产品的ProductKey。
ProductKey是物联网平台为新建产品颁发的全局唯一标识符。您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html，查看当前账号下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

Code.description_en: The response code. 200 indicates success. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 200表示成功。其它表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The trajectory information of the device returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回设备的轨迹信息

Points.description_en: The list of trajectory points. A maximum of 200 points are returned
Points.description_zh: 轨迹点列表，最多返回200个点

LocateTime.description_en: The time of the location point. This field is not returned if the trajectory has been corrected
LocateTime.description_zh: 位置点时间，如果是纠偏过的轨迹，则没有该字段

Location.description_en: The coordinates of the trajectory point, in the format of (longitude, latitude)
Location.description_zh: 轨迹点坐标，格式为：（经度，维度）

ProductKey.description_en: The productKey of the product to which the device belongs

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
